title: FarmRisk
description: An advanced agricultural intelligence platform integrating high-resolution remote sensing, satellite field mapping, and real-time climate data. Empowering farmers with localized risk mitigation analytics and predictive AI insights to optimize crop yield and operational sustainability.
heroHeading: Farmers face climate {{Uncertainty}} almost every day
heroSubheadingPart1: India experienced extreme weather events on 99% days in 2025
heroSubheadingPart3: 50% of India's crop area that is entirely rainfed.
locationRequiredDesc: FarmRisk needs your location to show weather, forecasts, and crop advisories. Please enable location access or search for your area.
tapToUnlockDesc: Tap to unlock full potential with AI advisory & real-time insights
unlockFullPotentialDesc: Create a free account or sign in to access advanced farm intelligence and personalized insights.
aiAdvisoryLockedDesc: Sign in or register to get tailored AI recommendations and harvest forecasts.
pestLockedDesc: Sign in or register to get real-time crop disease alerts and ICAR-backed treatment guidelines.
soilMoistureLockedDesc: Sign in or register to view field moisture levels, drought stress index, and irrigation guidance.
cropCalendarLockedDesc: Sign in or register to track seasonal sowing, growing, and harvesting periods for your crops.
activeCropLockedDesc: Sign in to select and lock in specific crop profiles for tailored risk models.
myFarmsLockedDesc: Sign in or register to draw, save, and export satellite boundary maps for your fields.
activeCropEmptyDesc: Select a crop to customize risk analysis
featureAiDesc: Get personalized actionable insights for your specific farm based on weather and soil data.
featurePestDesc: Early warnings for local pest and disease threats using predictive models.
featureSoilDesc: Detailed soil moisture profiles across 4 depth levels to optimize irrigation.
featureFarmsDesc: Draw and save your field boundaries for pinpoint accurate hyper-local forecasting.
